title: ArgOS simulator frame
description: GENERATED by tools/gen_snapshot_schema.py from config/signals.yaml; do not edit. What Simulator.step(tick, commands, inputs) returns for one tick: the readings that arrived this tick, the events it applied. Every reading's t_s is this tick (arrival time). A 1 Hz signal is present every tick; an event-rate signal only on the tick its report arrives; a dropped feed's signals are left out, never null. $defs.command and $defs.input type the two argument lists. Contract: docs/STATE_ESTIMATION.md.

transition.description: a change under way (an A.6 transition, a genset restart); the value moves linearly for numbers, enums keep the old value until the end tick

requests_value.description: open bridge confirmation requests, one per decision that asked

capacity_value.description: capacity of a live class; committed and free are ledger lines (ledger_rules)

zero_by_rule.description: 0 by rule (acoustic down, silence): demand is buffered

start.description: a run's starting state (signals.yaml baselines): raw signal name (Gx.key for guests) to its value at tick 0

event.description: an event the simulator applied at this tick (timeline or laptop); signals.yaml events

command.description: a command decided on snapshot n - 1 and applied by sim.step in frame n; seq is the decision record that sent it

input.description: a laptop input stamped with tick t_s, passed to sim.step(t_s, commands, inputs); events with to: core never reach the simulator
